about: Real photos of Futures Learning Center, 3625 S Blue Ridge Blvd, Independence, Missouri (the Futures Friends pilot center), from the original FLC website. No people in any photo. Resized to 400/800/1200 px wide as WebP + JPEG with all metadata (EXIF, GPS, ICC comments) stripped. Never add a concept render or AI image here.

photos.what: The building from the street corner: stone walls, the blue front door under the Futures sign at the left, two child-care flag banners on the lawn
photos.where: Outside, corner of the building and the front entrance

photos.what: A wide view of the main classroom: a grass mat with turtle stepping stones, a child-size table and chairs, an alphabet rug and cubby shelves
The carpet area: a large alphabet rug, small armchairs, the reading shelf and toy shelves
The reading corner: a bookshelf of picture books, a reading wall and a cushioned bench
The dress-up and toy corner: a shelf of toys, a rail of dress-up costumes, a small rug and a balance bike
A classroom with a blue table set with learning trays, a chalkboard easel, cubby shelves and days-of-the-week posters
photos.crop: 4:5, top kept (bottom strip of carpet trimmed)
